He used transfer checks, forged stamps and principal's seal to transfer money from cafeteria's special account to his mother's account, and later multiple transfers/withdrawals, total embezzlement 2.8295502 million yuan, with 1.76057467 million not yet returned. For state employees, they used "挪用公款". So answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes? He also forged stamps and seals, but the main charge is misappropriation of public funds. In examples, they didn't add "伪造印章" etc. So just one.
